commit 1a0304def857bff01a142600f7f58c8d9044a6a3
Author: Aakash Patel <avp@fb.com>
Date:   Sun Sep 20 23:15:55 2020 -0700

    Avoid potential access out of bounds lexing %checks.

    Summary:
    Make sure that `curCharPtr_` is sufficiently far from the end of
    the buffer that the compared `StringRef` is valid.

    Fix #361.

    Reviewed By: neildhar

    Differential Revision: D23809781

    fbshipit-source-id: 717d00120b92fae5a21319ba10a9a8cf4566e322
---
 lib/Parser/JSLexer.cpp | 1 +
 1 file changed, 1 insertion(+)

diff --git a/lib/Parser/JSLexer.cpp b/lib/Parser/JSLexer.cpp
index ba1b67e29..d38ed2880 100644
--- a/lib/Parser/JSLexer.cpp
+++ b/lib/Parser/JSLexer.cpp
@@ -314,6 +314,7 @@ const Token *JSLexer::advance(GrammarContext grammarContext) {
       token_.setStart(curCharPtr_);
         if (HERMES_PARSE_FLOW &&
             LLVM_UNLIKELY(grammarContext == GrammarContext::Flow) &&
+            curCharPtr_ + 7 <= bufferEnd_ &&
             llvh::StringRef(curCharPtr_, 7) == "%checks") {
           token_.setIdentifier(getStringLiteral("%checks"));
           curCharPtr_ += 7;
